metadata.question: Did the town of Marovoay have higher water extent in January 27, 2020 than January 18, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare water extent at two specific dates: Jan 27, 2020 vs Jan 18, 2017 - Location: Marovoay town (need to geocode or use coordinates) - Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection - For specific dates, Sentinel-1 is better than JRC monthly products 2. Masking strategy: - For Sentinel-1 VV polarization, water has low backscatter values - Apply threshold to detect water (typically VV < -15 dB) - No cloud masking needed for SAR data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water extent can genuinely be 0 (dry conditions) - this is a valid B answer - C1: No Sentinel-1 images available for these dates - C2: After processing, no valid pixels (unlikely with SAR) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water pixel counts between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Marovoay location (town in Madagascar) const marovoay = ee.Geometry.Point([46.6333, -16.1000]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around town // Date ranges (±3 days for better image availability) const date1_start = '2017-01-15'; const date1_end = '2017-01-21'; const date2_start = '2020-01-24'; const date2_end = '2020-01-30'; // Get Sentinel-1 data for 2017 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(marovoay) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data for Jan 2017'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get Sentinel-1 data for 2020 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(marovoay) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data for Jan 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process 2017 data const img1 = col1.select('VV').median(); const water1 = img1.lt(-15); // Water threshold const stats1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: marovoay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1 = stats1.VV; if (waterPixels1 === null || waterPixels1 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed for 2017'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Process 2020 data const img2 = col2.select('VV').median(); const water2 = img2.lt(-15); const stats2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: marovoay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2 = stats2.VV; if (waterPixels2 === null || waterPixels2 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed for 2020'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Jan 2017 water pixels: ${waterPixels1}`); console.log(`Jan 2020 water pixels: ${waterPixels2}`); const waterArea1 = waterPixels1 * 1000 * 1000 / 1e6; // km² const waterArea2 = waterPixels2 * 1000 * 1000 / 1e6; // km² console.log(`Jan 2017 water extent: ${waterArea1.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Jan 2020 water extent: ${waterArea2.toFixed(2)} km²`); if (waterPixels2 > waterPixels1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
